simple.meaning: מַעֲשֶׂה (maʻăseh) appears 235 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a brother in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 7 more, beginning at Genesis 5:29. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, kingship, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַעֲשֶׂה (H4639) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows מַעֲשֶׂה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: מַעֲשֶׂה (maʻăseh) / H4639 is tracked through Genesis 5:29, Genesis 20:9, Genesis 40:17, Genesis 44:15. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.short: an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction ; abstractly, activity ; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem ) or (generally) property
definitions.usage: act, art, bakemeat, business, deed, do(-ing), labor, thing made, ware of making, occupation, thing offered, operation, possession, × well, (handy-, needle-, net-) work(ing, -manship), wrought.
definitions.full: H4639. maaseh מַעֲשֶׂה 233 noun masculine Gen 20:9 deed, work ; — absolute ׳מ 44:15 +, construct מַעֲשֵׂה Isa 5:12 +; suffix מַעֲשֵׂהוּ Judg 13:12 +, etc.; plural מַעֲשִׂים Gen 20:9 +; construct מַעֲשֵׂי Jer 1:16 +; suffix מַעֲשָׂיו 1Sam 19:4 (or singular, so Dr) +, etc.; — often accusative of congnate meaning with verb with עשׂה ; — 1. a. -1 deed, thing done by man Num 16:28 (JE), 1Kin 13:11 ; Isa 26:12 ; — b. -1 work, labour , husbandry Exod 23:16 (E), Gen 5:29 (J), Judg 19:16 , c. deed(s), work(s) of ׳י , especially in deliverance and in judgment, Judg 2:7 , 10 ; Josh 24:31 (D), Psa 33:4 21 t., + ׳מ יָדָיו etc. Isa 5:12 ; Psa 28:5 ; 92:5 4 t.; ׳מ הָאֱלֹהִים in General Eccl 7:13 ; 8:17 ; 11:5 ; compare 3:11 . 2. a. -1 work, thing made , by man, ׳מ אֹפֶה b. work (made by) God Exod 32:16 (E); especially (poetry and late), of created things, Psa 103:22 ; 104:24 4 t. Psalms; ׳מ אֶצְבְּעֹתֶיךָ 8:4 , ׳מ יָרֶיךָ 102:26 (both of heavens), compare 19:2 (heavenly bodies), 8:7 (animals); of man Job 14:15 ; 34:19 , compare מַעֲשֵׂהוּ כָּלאַֿנְשֵׁי לָדַעַת 37:7 (but read probably ᵑ9 אנשׁים Ol Di and others); of nation Isa 19:25 ; 60:21 ; 64:7 ; of weights Prov 16:11 (but read perhaps הַמֶּלֶךְ ) for ׳י Gr Toy). c. product of olive-tree, ׳מ זַיִת Hab 3:17 ; figurative product of righteousness Isa 32:17 .
